ethnic_groups.notes: Fitri Lake region; historically challenged Kanem dynasty

natural_resources.notes: Oil production since 2003 (Doba Basin, Chad-Cameroon pipeline); World Bank oil revenue management experiment (failed—Chad broke agreement); Lake Chad shrinking 90% since 1960s (from 25,000 km² to ~1,500 km²); uranium at Aozou Strip

military.notes: France's primary Sahel military ally (Operation Barkhane HQ in N'Djamena until 2024); Chadian soldiers considered best fighters in Sahel; Déby killed fighting rebels in front lines 2021; Multinational Joint Task Force vs Boko Haram; France withdrawing military presence 2024

infrastructure.notes: Landlocked; Chad-Cameroon pipeline only major infrastructure; most roads impassable in rainy season.

debt_aid.notes: Heavily aid-dependent; oil revenues mismanaged; Glencore oil-backed loans; World Bank Chad-Cameroon pipeline revenue management collapsed; HIPC beneficiary

education.notes: Lowest literacy rate globally (22.3%); enormous gender gap (14% female literacy); Arabic/French dual system; nomadic populations hard to reach; Boko Haram closing schools in Lake region; Quranic schools predominant in north

diaspora_migration.notes: Hosts largest refugee population relative to economy (Sudanese from Darfur ~370k, CAR ~115k); Chadian rebels operated from Libya/Sudan; Lake Chad Basin displacement crisis ~3M

digital_economy.notes: Minimal digital economy; internet among most expensive in Africa; 18-month internet shutdown 2018-19 (world's longest at that time); Tigo Chad primary mobile operator; no meaningful tech ecosystem; electricity access 11% constrains digital growth

country_profile.notes_unique: Home to the oldest known hominid fossil (Sahelanthropus tchadensis, c. 7 million years); Lake Chad has shrunk by 90% since the 1960s due to climate change.

geography.terrain: Arid plains in center; desert in north (Sahara); mountains in northwest (Tibesti); tropical lowlands in south
geography.notes: Lake Chad has shrunk 90% since 1960s; Tibesti Mountains contain Africa's highest Saharan peak; Ennedi Plateau has rock art; Sahel belt crosses country.

economy_extended.notes: Oil-dependent economy (~60% government revenue); Doba oil fields (ExxonMobil); severely impacted by oil price drops; cotton major non-oil export.

health.notes: Among world's highest maternal mortality; severe doctor shortage; most health facilities in N'Djamena; hosts 1M+ refugees (Sudan, CAR) straining system.

food_agriculture.notes: Sahel drought and desertification threaten agriculture; pastoralism important in north; Lake Chad basin irrigation declining as lake shrinks.

energy.notes: Oil exporter but very low electrification; Djermaya refinery (domestic supply); biomass dominant for households; Saharan solar potential untapped.

transport.notes: Landlocked; no railways; Chad-Cameroon oil pipeline (1070km) for oil export; mostly unpaved roads.

unesco_sites_list: Ennedi Massif: Natural and Cultural Landscape
tourism.notes: Adventure tourism emerging (Ennedi, Tibesti); insecurity limits growth; Zakouma elephant recovery success story.

human_rights_gender.notes: Military-dominated politics since 2021 transition; high child marriage and FGM; press freedom severely restricted.

security_stability.notes: Key regional military power; French military base (Adji Kossei, reduced post-2024); hosts 1M+ refugees from Sudan conflict; Multinational Joint Task Force (MNJTF) contributor.

cultural_heritage.media_landscape: State-controlled; few independent outlets; internet shutdowns common
cultural_heritage.notes: Crossroads of Islamic and Christian/animist cultures; 200+ ethnic groups; Saharan rock art testifies to 7000+ year human presence.

legal_system.legal_tradition: Civil law (French heritage); Islamic law in north
legal_system.customary_law_role: Prevalent in rural and southern areas
legal_system.notes: 2021 military transition; Transitional Military Council ruling; constitution suspended then revised; Habré trial by AU Extraordinary Chambers in Senegal.

comparative_rankings._note: Country position relative to continent and global.
